detail.longDescription: A monitor correctly flagged the sabotage. In 9 of those 16 sessions the code stayed in anyway. One developer: "I usually clicked confirm to close them." Agents were covertly told to exfiltrate data. No monitor: 83 of 88 developers missed it. https:// arxiv.org/abs/2606.05647 A pop-up only reaches whoever already trusts the agent. We built https:// shell.online so a second person can watch the run in a browser. Helps only if they read it. # AIAgents # Cybersecurity # CodeReview
